map.由信号功率与噪声功率求信噪比: SNR from signal power and noise power
map.信号功率 S 与噪声功率 N 之比转换为分贝：SNR_dB = 10·log₁₀: Convert the ratio of signal power S to noise power N into decibels: SNR_dB = 10·log10(S/N), or use the voltage ratio 20·log10(V_s/V_n).
map.📖 查看「由信号功率与噪声功率求信噪比 使用指南」: View "SNR from signal power and noise power" guide
map.输入信号功率 Ps 与噪声功率 Pn，求信噪比（dB）。: Enter signal power Ps and noise power Pn to find the SNR (dB).
map.ps 与噪声功率 pn 取 10log10 得 SNR。: Taking 10log10 of ps and noise power pn gives the SNR.
map.通信质量、ADC 有效位评估。: Communication quality and ADC effective-bit evaluation.
map.SNR = 10×log10(10/0.1) = 10×log10(100) =: SNR = 10xlog10(10/0.1) = 10xlog10(100) = 20 dB; raising noise to 1 drops the SNR to 10dB.
map.一般 SNR>20dB 较清晰，<10dB 噪声明显、难以分辨。: Generally SNR>20dB is clear, while <10dB has obvious noise and is hard to distinguish.
map.SNR 单位一定是 dB 吗？: Must the SNR unit be dB?
map.也可用比值（线性），dB 更方便跨数量级表达。: A ratio (linear) can also be used; dB is more convenient across orders of magnitude.
map.SNR 越高越好吗？: Is a higher SNR always better?
map.通常越高越清晰，但过高可能意味信号过强或系统动态范围浪费。: Usually higher is clearer, but too high may mean the signal is too strong or the system dynamic range is wasted.
